name: jackson-databind
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text mapped to untyped Map/List/String/Number/Boolean/null
family: Jackson (jackson-core streaming parser + databind untyped mapping)
family_note: ObjectMapper drives the jackson-core JsonParser and maps tokens through UntypedObjectDeserializer. The separately selected jackson-core path exposes that same tokenizer directly; the two selected API paths are one parser family, not independent engines.
configuration_note: The adapter disables JsonFactory.Feature.CANONICALIZE_FIELD_NAMES (documented, default on). With it on, jackson-core's ByteQuadsCanonicalizer seeds its field-name hash from System.currentTimeMillis(), and repeated runs on the same control covered different ByteQuadsCanonicalizer lines. With it off, repeated control coverage is identical. The rest of the parse path is the default ObjectMapper configuration.

name: jackson-core
license_evidence: Maven release POM licenses; pinned POM SHA256 in source-lock.json
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text tokenized directly from local stream; adapter consumes all tokens and summarizes structure
family_note: The same jackson-core tokenizer is driven by selected jackson-databind. This is a distinct package/API path, not an independent parser engine.
configuration_note: CANONICALIZE_FIELD_NAMES is disabled to avoid wall-clock-seeded ByteQuadsCanonicalizer coverage variance; the direct JsonParser token stream otherwise uses default factory behavior. Adapter requires one complete root and consumes the token stream.

name: gson
input_api: new Gson().fromJson(Reader, Object.class) over InputStreamReader(FileInputStream, UTF_8)
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text mapped to untyped LinkedTreeMap/ArrayList/String/Double/Boolean/null
family_note: Gson tokenizes with its own com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader and maps tokens through ObjectTypeAdapter. It shares no code with jackson-core or jackson-databind, so it is a parser family independent of the selected Jackson path.
configuration_note: Default Gson instance (Strictness.LEGACY_STRICT, ToNumberPolicy.DOUBLE for Object targets). fromJson(Reader, ...) also checks that the document is fully consumed.

name: json
license_evidence: Pinned Maven release POM declares Public Domain; upstream release history records switch in 20220924, prior to this release. POM SHA256 in source-lock.json.
input_api: new JSONTokener(InputStreamReader(FileInputStream, UTF_8), new JSONParserConfiguration().withStrictMode()).nextValue(); nextClean() checks end of local document
scope: Valid RFC 8259 nested object/array controls parsed from local UTF-8 Reader into JSONObject/JSONArray; adapter converts to untyped Map/List and checks one complete root
family_note: The source jar implements its own JSONTokener and JSONObject/JSONArray parsers. No Jackson, Gson, or fastjson2 parser dependency appears in the pinned release POM.
configuration_note: Uses the documented JSONParserConfiguration.withStrictMode() to require JSON quoting rules on this path; the adapter additionally checks nextClean()==0 after one root.

name: json-smart
license_evidence: Maven release POM licenses; POM SHA256 in source-lock.json
scope: Valid nested RFC 4627 JSON object/array documents from local UTF-8 bytes, mapped to Map/List/String/Number/Boolean/null
family_note: net.minidev.json.parser contains the tokenizer and object/array parse logic. accessors-smart and ASM are runtime dependencies but not JSON tokenizers. This parser family is independent of Jackson, Gson, and fastjson2.
